title: Apple schedules 'Pro and tell' event for October 28
excerpt: Apple is preparing for another hardware launch event titled 'Pro and tell' scheduled for October 28th in Los Angeles.
body_html:
Apple has announced a new hardware launch event named 'Pro and tell'. The gathering is scheduled to take place on October 28th at 1:00 PM Eastern Time in Los Angeles.

Based on expectations surrounding the schedule, the upcoming presentation is anticipated to focus primarily on updates to the MacBook Pro line. This follows previous recent company announcements, including the Welcome Home event and the iPhone Duo reveal.

Further details regarding the specific products and updates to be revealed during the Los Angeles gathering have not been detailed ahead of the scheduled date.
